status: post-hoc development-set assessment, not independent confirmation
association: dominant topic per spectrum; unique connectivity compounds within each topic
fingerprint: RDKit MACCS positions 1 through 166; position 0 unused
strata: sorted unique (adduct, collision_energy) acquisition pairs per compound, crossed with floor(median precursor_mz / width_da)
scaffold_selection: smallest SHA256(connectivity_key) per nonempty scaffold; each acyclic connectivity is its own group
sos_test: whole fingerprint vectors shuffled within compound strata; identical draws for all six fits; upper tail including ties; p=(1+b)/(1+B)
enrichment_test: exact convolution of independent stratum-specific hypergeometric count distributions; upper tail including observed count
multiplicity: Benjamini-Yekutieli across six fits: 6000 SOS slots, separately 996000 motif-feature slots. Unavailable/constant slots contribute p=1. Each fixed configuration has its own family; sensitivities are not selected for significance.
stability: full-beta cosine and Hungarian matching for all 15 fit pairs; reciprocal nearest neighbours, top-20 Jaccard, compound Jaccard and cosine of matched-background feature-prevalence differences
redundancy: within-fit nearest full-beta cosine and exact repeated available MAG consensus fingerprints
reference_matching: existing Spec2Vec model and Mass2MotifDocument at 2 decimals; top-20 learned words; reference signatures use both typed mass-intensity channels, normalized jointly to maximum intensity; ignore auto_annotation as truth; retain all conflicting manual labels
reference_overlap: maximum cardinality one-to-one mass matching separately within fragment and neutral-loss channels; report each channel's matched count and both denominators
plain_etm_exclusion: only two complete local repeat fits; the historical third fit has summary evidence only. Retained in existing report comparison, omitted from new assessments without retraining or imputation.
interpretation: Conditional exploratory associations, not calibrated post-selection significance, expert confirmation, fragmentation mechanisms, or novel chemistry. Report all topics, missingness, effect distributions and weak/negative results. Training-run SD, Monte Carlo precision and background sensitivities are distinct. Fit-pair comparisons are dependent. MotifDB and MAG evidence are correlated.
